title: AgentEscrow
summary: Create and fund an SPL-token escrow, let the provider start and submit work, then confirm so the provider is paid (minus a 0.5% protocol fee).
what: AgentEscrow is an Anchor 0.30.1 rail for AI-agent payments: the payer creates and funds a vault PDA, the provider starts and submits work, and confirm_completion releases 99.5% of the amount to the provider and 0.5% to a treasury token account. This lesson covers that happy path. Dispute/timeout/verifier instructions exist in the program but are not in this IDL.
app_note: The page at /dapps/agentescrow/ is the generic IDL-driven wallet console, with this devnet program id filled in. The hosted IDL is a hand-derived subset; discriminators were confirmed by the verifying transactions. The lab tree is branch sol-college-devnet of Blockchains/agentescrow (unique declare_id plus a vault-PDA bump fix so signed SPL transfers work).

try_steps.do: Open /dapps/agentescrow/, switch to Devnet, and connect a wallet. The lab already ran create_escrow → fund_escrow → start_work → submit_work → confirm_completion with 1_000_000 units of the lab mint.
try_steps.see: Program 9bMFKrje…. Escrow 3X8DZn9u… should be Released; vault 4PPYT1tJ… should be empty; provider ATA gained 995_000, treasury ATA gained 5_000.

try_steps.do: A second create_escrow for the same payer should fail (seeds [payer, "escrow"] allow only one escrow PDA per payer).
try_steps.see: The account already exists (Simulation failed / account in use).

diagram: payer --create_escrow--> escrow [payer, "escrow"] ; payer --fund_escrow--> vault [escrow, "vault"] (SPL) ; provider --start_work/submit_work--> PendingReview ; payer --confirm_completion--> provider 99.5% + treasury 0.5%
accounts: vault (SPL token account PDA, seeds [escrow, "vault"], authority = vault)
payer / provider / treasury associated token accounts of the escrow mint
instructions: trigger_timeout / open_dispute / cast_vote / resolve_dispute / register_verifier exist in the program but are not in this IDL
innovation: A self-authorized vault PDA for SPL escrow between two agents, with a fixed 0.5% protocol fee on release.
exercises: Fetch the lab escrow and confirm state is Released.
Explain why the signed transfer must use the vault PDA bump, not escrow.bump.
Sketch how a second escrow for the same payer would need a different seed (for example a nonce).
not_covered: trigger_timeout, open_dispute, cast_vote, resolve_dispute, and verifier registration were not exercised. The hosted IDL is a hand-derived subset confirmed by the verifying transactions.
objectives: Create and fund an SPL-token escrow vault PDA for an agent job.
Explain the provider start → submit → payer confirm sequence.
Identify which accounts hold funds before and after confirmation.
prereqs: A Phantom or Solflare wallet on Solana Devnet with practice SOL and the lesson mint if required.
Comfortable with [accounts and authority](/lessons/accounts-ownership/) or equivalent.
student_outcome: Fund an agent escrow and confirm a provider submission so payout can proceed.
